notes: šəḇuʿaṯ ʾissār is rendered attributively as binding oath, so rule 28 governs and no of is placed.
The anarthrous nāp̄eš takes the supplied the under rule 15, the determiner belonging to the noun that licenses it.
make ... void is discontinuous around the object pronoun it under rule 25, the suffix taking that pronoun under rule 18 and the head staying on the complement under rule 44.
